$comment: The kinds a listed name can have, and what each means for a session: an agent is AI or automation working for a human; a bot is a named program that is not an agent. 'row' is the line of the dashboard's Agent block an agent kind is counted in ('ai': AI in a real browser; 'automated': Automated browser). A 'generic' kind names a tool anyone can run, so a more specific name matched in the same User-Agent wins over it. A 'browser' kind names a browser people also use by hand, such as an AI desktop app's own browser: the name says where the page is open, not who acts in it, so it names the agent when one acts and never makes a session an agent's (agentcake/detect/attribute.py). Labels are interface text (English only).
